build_combined_roidb_for_training: build a roidb for training by loading and concatenating multiple datasets with optional object proposals
create_flipped_entries: create horizontally flipped training entries by flipping boxes, segmentations, and keypoints in the roidb
filter_roidb_for_training: filter roidb entries to remove images with no usable foreground or background RoIs
compute_bbox_regression_targets: compute bounding-box regression targets for each roidb entry using IoU overlap with ground-truth ROIs
review_compute_and_log_stats: review the ground-truth class histogram statistics computed and logged for a given roidb
